title: Bounded-above resolutions from a quotient-generating class
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $\mathcal P\subset\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal A)$ contain a zero object, and assume every object of $\mathcal A$ is a quotient of an object of $\mathcal P$. Let $a\in\mathbf Z$. If $K^\bullet$ is a cochain complex [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $K^n=0$ for every $n>a$, then there exist a cochain complex $P^\bullet$ and a quasi-isomorphism $P^\bullet\to K^\bullet$ such that every $P^n$ lies in $\mathcal P$, every component $P^n\to K^n$ is an epimorphism, and $P^n=0$ for every $n>a$.
